provenance.meaning: Runtime scoring parameters printed by XCom_Challenge, not earned points.
Explicit SDK structure defaults for otherwise unknown enemy templates; not evidence of a runtime Ladder INI override.
Only the first injury loses the uninjured allowance. Healing does not refund it. Death and confirmed LadderUnkillable knockout are losses.

comparison_conventions.turn_decay: max(min_points, starting_points - max(0, turn - turn_offset) * decrease_per_turn)
comparison_conventions.note: The received SDK exposes AddKillMail and objective scoring as native functions. The boundary convention above defines this comparison profile; an observed native score always takes precedence.
comparison_conventions.soldier_allowance: Each confirmed eligible observed soldier starts with the uninjured and survival allowances, then loses each at most once in the comparison.
comparison_conventions.objective_coverage: Only explicit recorded objective completions are scored; victory does not imply that every optional objective was completed.
comparison_conventions.unknown_enemy_origin: Ordinary-enemy points are a provisional observed component until spawned/reinforcement origin is known.
comparison_conventions.completion_scope: A complete comparison covers the included categories and public observations only; it is never the complete native game score.
